stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def bbox(g):
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=g[0][0] and True]
    # find non-bg cells: any cell differing from the dominant bg
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ps=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
    return bg, ps

def hypo(b):
    rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[[b[0][0] for _ in range(c1-c0+1)] for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
    return None

for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[n+' input']; go=G[n+' output']
    bg,ps=bbox(gi)
    print(n,'bg',bg,'dots',ps)
    # output non-bg cells
    cnt=Counter(x for row in go for x in row)
    obg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    oout=set()
    for r,row in enumerate(go):
        for c,x in enumerate(row):
            if x!=obg: oout.add((r,c))
    print(' out cells',len(oout), sorted(oout)[:15])
